title: Eternal Space
description: Eternal SpaceEternal Space is a city management and a space exploration/combat game. Expand your city while you uncover the secrets in space.Manage your cityControl your city your way. Keep your citizens happy by constructing Hospitals to keep them healthy and Police Hubs to keep them safe. Collect taxes each year for a little bonus too. Expand your city by constructing buildings and make your citizens happy.ExploreExplore the Eternal Space. There is always something new out there.FightFight pirates, or become a pirate! Pirates earn a lot of credits, but that also comes at some risk.FreightersPurchase and manage your own Freighter at the cost of 5 milion credits! Craft Tritium-cells to be able to refuel it, jump with it to new locations and do things you never would be able to do without it!
description_short: Eternal Space is a city builder and space exploration/combat game. Explore the Eternal Space, and manage your city while you fight pirates, or maybe even become a pirate! Keep your citizens happy, and collect taxes from them each year for a little bonus!
